title: Book an interpreter for spoken language
summary: You can request a quote and book an interpreter through Multicultural NSW if you need help understanding spoken English.
intro:
If you need help with understanding spoken English, you can request a quote and book an interpreter through Multicultural NSW. Interpretation services are available in 120 languages and dialects, including Australian Sign Language (Auslan).

You can request a face-to-face, video or telephone interpreter for a wide range of needs, including:

For help with written documents, you can apply for document translation services.
what_you_need: the time and date you need language interpreter help
your Multicultural NSW Language Services account number (if you have one)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the steps to submit a request.

more_info.text: Requests for a language interpreter should be made in advance whenever possible.
Fees apply to language interpreter services.
Cancellation fees apply when bookings are cancelled within 48 hours of the booked starting time.

faqs.q: What types of interpreting services are available?
faqs.a: You can request face-to-face, video, or telephone interpreters for a wide range of needs.

faqs.q: Are interpreter services available for written documents?
faqs.a: For help with written documents, you can apply for document translation services.

faqs.q: Who can apply for interpreter services?
faqs.a: Services are available to individuals, community groups, private and commercial organisations, and all NSW Government departments and agencies.
